reference: Low-level cases compare the util-linux blkid executable on regular image files. Other probe cases use independently encoded metadata and literal expectations.
coverage: Bash builtin availability and documented help text (metadata only).
Documented regular-file probe behavior for independently encoded ext2 LABEL/UUID/TYPE, FAT LABEL/UUID/TYPE, and MBR PTTYPE.
Value, filtered export, default, and multiple-operand output contracts.
Low-level filesystem and usage filters, tag selection, and an unidentified regular file.
exclusions: No real block device is opened or probed; fixtures are relative regular files in the runner private tree.
No-operand /sys enumeration and -L/-U discovery need a controlled device namespace or mock and are deferred.
Only ext2, VFAT, and an MBR signature are covered; other filesystem and GPT signatures, parent-disk GPT partition metadata, and the complete util-linux option surface are not covered.

cases.purpose: Bash metadata contract: the selected command is registered as a builtin, without invoking its probe operation.
Bash help exposes the description documented by the pinned loadable source; no device operation is invoked.
Probe an independently encoded ext2 superblock and compare the documented value output for TYPE, LABEL, and canonical UUID.
cases.script:
zeros() {
  local n=$1
  while (( n >= 256 )); do
    printf '\0%.0s' {1..256}
    n=$((n - 256))
  done
  while (( n > 0 )); do
    printf '\0'
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
}
: > ext.img
zeros 1024 >> ext.img
printf '\x10\x00\x00\x00\x40\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x3c\x00\x00\x00\x0e\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x40\x00\x00\x00\x40\x00\x00\x00\x10\x00\x00\x00' >> ext.img
zeros 12 >> ext.img
printf '\x53\xef\x01\x00\x01\x00' >> ext.img
zeros 14 >> ext.img
printf '\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x0b\x00\x00\x00\x80\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x03\x00\x00\x00' >> ext.img
printf '\x01\x23\x45\x67\x89\xab\xcd\xef\x10\x32\x54\x76\x98\xba\xdc\xfe' >> ext.img
printf 'FIXTURE_EXT     ' >> ext.img
zeros 64376 >> ext.img
blkid -s TYPE -o value ext.img
blkid -s LABEL -o value ext.img
blkid -s UUID -o value ext.img

cases.purpose: Probe a deterministic FAT16-style BPB, padded to the 2880 sectors it declares, and compare its type, little-endian volume serial and boot-sector label. As in util-linux 2.41 blkid on the same image, the boot-sector label is LABEL_FATBOOT and LABEL (the root-directory label) is absent.

zeros() {
  local n=$1

    printf '\0%.0s' {1..256}
    n=$((n - 256))
  done
  while (( n > 0 )); do

    n=$((n - 1))

blkid -s TYPE -o value vfat.img
blkid -s LABEL -o value vfat.img
blkid -s UUID -o value vfat.img

cases.purpose: An output format blkid does not know is rejected before any probing, as util-linux 2.41 blkid does: 'unsupported output format FORMAT' and status 4 (blkid(8): usage or other errors), with no data printed. Guest pass 9 (G129) replaced the earlier status-2 contract.
No-operand enumeration and -L/-U discovery are core operations that cannot be compared safely against ambient device state.

cases.purpose: An image with no signature produces empty output and exits 2.

G129 (verified against util-linux 2.41 blkid, which exits 1 for these, not the 4 that blkid(8) lists): getopt wording, the Try line and status 1 for unknown options, missing arguments and an argument given to a flag; an unknown output format is status 4.
cases.script:
blkid --bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -@ </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -x </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -o </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -s </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid --output </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid --probe=1 </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -O </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -p --bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
blkid -o bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
